posts.title_en: Isn't Macaron still the conquest ceiling?
posts.summary_en: The poster argues that dropping from 다발 3 to 다발 2 costs a beam among Milk, Seeker, Cheesecake, Tea Knight and Skating Queen, so Macaron may still be the ceiling. Commenters answer that Tiger Lily stays in the deck, so Chardonnay replaces only Macaron; one notes 70%+ of conquest damage comes from Brightseeker and that the ceiling needs Tiger Lily's 다발 to reach Pomegranate.
mechanics: Tiger Lily stays: Chardonnay replaces Macaron, not Tiger Lily (comments).
Over 70% of conquest damage comes from Brightseeker (the author, stated).
disagreements: Author: the ceiling is Macaron, because Chardonnay's 다발 2 costs a beam. Commenters: Tiger Lily is kept, so the beam count is unchanged and Chardonnay beats Macaron.
quotes: 어짜피 토벌딜의 70퍼센트 이상이 시커한테 나오는데 딜러 하나추가해봐야 석류한테 정전 다발안드가면 고점못찍음

posts.summary_en: 서신우's cafe post for his video RKNiw1fRosw: a result frame at 2,501,105,826,814 with the timer at 0.000 (the team survived to the end). In comments he gives the conquest gear: weapons skill amp + crit rate (some say flat ATK is better), armour damage reduction + HP (crit resistance is a filler line), top accessories haste + skill amp, bottom accessories damage reduction + haste. Melon Soda is held under Scorpion's ATK after Octo Wasabi's buff; only Scorpion needs the ATK sum, since Milk, Seeker and Skating Queen all get the pet's buff. A commenter (로얄이) went from 1.8T to 4T 'easily' after the patch and says Strawberry Crepe in the Cherry slot worked best for him, and to try other Light dealers there; his guild has a higher deck it won't share.

disagreements: Weapons: crit rate (서신우) vs flat ATK (others, see dc-3 84162).
quotes: 무기 3개 증폭 + 치확 (공격력이 더 좋다는 말도 있는데 일단 치확 씀)
